messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the DP handoff criteria and an "opportunity sculpting" process before sprint planning. Goal: recruit ~8 design partners, run 2-week pilots, and have clear go/no-go metrics.

anton: Sounds good. How much overlap with the private beta cohort? We should avoid double-inviting the same teams.

linh: +1 on avoiding overlap. Suggest a short scoping workshop per partner (30–45m) to capture must-haves vs nice-to-haves. I have a template we can reuse: https://tiny.redwood/scoping-template

ravi: FYI we also need legal + infra checks: NDAs (standard) and any HSM/KMS gating for private customers. Timeline might slip if HSM approvals take >2 weeks.

maya: Draft acceptance criteria (proposal):
```
- Eng integrations complete (SDK + sample app)
- 2 live user flows validated by partner
- Regression delta <= 2% on core prompt suite
- Weekly feedback loop: synth-evals + triage tickets
- Commitment: partner provides 2 product days/month during pilot
```
Thoughts?

samir: Two quick infra notes: we should guarantee a min throughput window during partner demos — propose 200 rps burst for demo windows. Also define fallback policy: if Dedicated capacity unavailable, auto-route to compatible smaller model and label degrade to customer.

anton: For prioritization of asks during the pilot, I propose a simple score: Impact * Urgency * Feasibility. We can runnable a 1–5 scorecard per feature. I'll sketch a sheet.

linh: Recruiting message snippet (short):
"Hi — Redwood's running a 2-week pilot for our inference runtime. We can offer tailored capacity + engineering support. Looking for partners who: 1) have a live flow to test, 2) can commit ~8–12 hours/week, 3) can share feedback in weekly sessions. Interested?"

ravi: @maya please loop legal on the HSM bit — we'll need a one-page SOW addendum for partners who require KMS/HSM integration.

maya: Owners: anton -> recruitment outreach & scorecard, samir -> infra capacity + fallback policy, linh -> scoping workshop template + ops runbook, ravi -> legal/SOW. Milestones: draft outreach & SOW by Tue EOD, schedule scoping workshops w/in 5 business days, first cohort onboarded by month-end.

ops-bot: Calendar: provisional event 'DP Scoping Workshops' created for next Wed 10:00–13:00. Invite sent to owners.

ravi: Noted. I'll start a SOW draft and ping security for HSM checklist.

maya: Great — thanks all. I'll assemble the outreach email and the acceptance checklist into a single doc and share tomorrow. Aim to get partner signoffs + SOW countersigned by Fri. :rocket:
